name: Edmond
source:
Of noble birth, Edmond holds the position of Vice-Captain of the Knights of the Klein Kingdom. Highly disciplined, well-educated and possessing impeccable manners, he values honor and duty above all else. Despite his objections to the use of magic, he receives an order from the king to assist Eiden and the others in their duties.

[From the [url=https://nucarnival.com/en-US/Characters/Edmond]official website[/url]]
